knownRuntimeNotes: The current publisher emits the string NaN when magnitude is null; this avoids invalid JSON but does not match an ideal numeric null-handling strategy.
The current resultTime is the publisher clock, not the feed metadata.generated time.
The current dedupe cache is in-memory only and does not survive process restart.
nonGoals: Do not create one system per earthquake
Do not fetch every detail document on every cycle by default
Do not mirror the full products structure into the default observation result
